heading: Results that prove the programme
description: Real enterprise deployments where Tag RoBo Tech turned physical assets into auditable, searchable, and actionable records.

items.title: PAN-India FAR verification for a multi-site enterprise
items.excerpt: A national operator needed a single Fixed Asset Register that matched the floor. Our teams tagged, scanned, and reconciled lakhs of assets across NCR campuses — closing gaps between books and reality, and handing finance a clean FAR they could defend in audit.
items.image_alt: Fixed asset verification teams on site

items.title: RFID asset tracking across manufacturing plants
items.excerpt: Plant managers were losing hours chasing tools and WIP. We deployed RFID handheld and fixed readers with Footprints dashboards so movements show up in real time — fewer stockouts, faster line changeovers, and clearer ownership on every shift.
items.image_alt: RFID asset tracking on a manufacturing floor

items.title: Equipment visibility for healthcare networks
items.excerpt: Hospitals need location without disrupting care. BLE and RFID tagging of critical equipment cut search time for biomedical teams and improved utilisation reporting for leadership — with workflows that nurses and technicians actually follow.
